shortDescription: Manage all ALPACA Operator commands of a specific system via REST API

options.name: api_connection
options.description: Connection details for accessing the ALPACA Operator API.

options.name: commands
options.description: List of desired commands to manage. Each command can include fields such as O(commands.name), O(commands.agent_id) or O(commands.agent_name), O(commands.process_id), O(commands.parameters), O(commands.schedule), O(commands.history), O(commands.escalation), etc.

options.name: system
options.description: Dictionary containing system identification. Either O(system.system_id) or O(system.system_name) must be provided.
